_comment: All-encompassing configuration for full_data_aggregation_pipeline.py. This file is the single place to control how the pipeline runs. The pipeline reads it by default (override with --config PATH or ignore with --no-config). Any CLI flag overrides the matching value here; booleans support --flag / --no-flag (e.g. --no-skip-download).

_pipeline_docs.skip_download: Skip the download_source_data step (source data already local).
_pipeline_docs.overwrite: Forward --overwrite to steps that skip existing outputs by default (gene aggregation, pairwise, filtered, analysis). The score/eval/percentile steps always rewrite regardless.
_pipeline_docs.compact_dtypes: Build the whole run in the compact numeric dtype profile (chrom UTINYINT, pos UINTEGER, ref/alt UTINYINT single-byte ASCII [reversible via chr(); non-SNV rows (multi-character indels/MNVs) are DROPPED], is_pos BOOLEAN, score DOUBLE). Default false = the historical types (chrom VARCHAR, pos BIGINT, ref/alt VARCHAR, is_pos BOOLEAN, score FLOAT), keeping all rows. Forwarded (via each step's 'passthrough') only to the steps that set or re-derive the variant key/values, so every table in a run stays join-compatible.
_pipeline_docs.memory_limit: DuckDB memory limit forwarded to every DuckDB step, e.g. '20GB' (null = DuckDB default).
_pipeline_docs.threads: DuckDB worker threads forwarded to every DuckDB step (null = DuckDB auto).
_pipeline_docs.temp_dir: Spill/build scratch dir forwarded to every DuckDB step (null = each script's default).
_pipeline_docs.report_dir: Directory for the aggregation_pipeline_*.json audit (null = merge_v2/pipeline_runs).
_pipeline_docs.count_text_inputs: Also count rows of raw TSV/bgz text sources (full scan; slow). Parquet is always counted from footer metadata.
_pipeline_docs.continue_on_error: Keep running subsequent steps even if one fails (default: stop at first failure).
_pipeline_docs.only: Run only these step name(s) (list), mutually exclusive with from_step/to_step.
_pipeline_docs.from_step: Start at this step name (inclusive); useful to resume after a failure.

_steps_docs: Ordered list of script invocations. Each step: 'name' (audit label + selection key), 'script' (file in this src/ dir), 'args' (extra CLI args passed to that script), 'passthrough' (which pipeline-level options to forward: any of memory_limit, threads, temp_dir, overwrite), and 'enabled' (set false to skip the step entirely). The obs/exp eval sources are included in the variant eval merge (corrected upstream by filtering to missense via the linker), so the former '--exclude _obs_exp_mis' guard is removed.
_pairwise_analysis_routes: There are two ways to turn the pairwise score tables (scores/pairwise/{raw,pre,post}) into analysis tables; choose one by toggling steps here. ROUTE (i) INDIVIDUAL PAIRS: leave create_pairwise_consolidated_score_tables disabled and set create_analysis_tables args to ['--groups','pairwise'] -> one analysis table per anchor/non-anchor pair per flavor under full_analysis_tables/pairwise/<flavor>/. ROUTE (ii) CONSOLIDATED: enable create_pairwise_consolidated_score_tables and set create_analysis_tables args to ['--groups','pairwise_consolidated'] -> the consolidation step first collapses each flavor's per-pair files into a single scores/pairwise_consolidated/pairwise_<flavor>_consolidated.parquet (coalescing the anchor for raw/pre; for post keeping every per-pair anchor percentile renamed ..._<anchor>_x_<non_anchor>), then the analysis step writes one analysis table per flavor under full_analysis_tables/pairwise_consolidated/. Either route requires create_pairwise_score_tables to have produced the per-pair files first. The two groups can also be combined in one create_analysis_tables run, e.g. ['--groups','pairwise','pairwise_consolidated'].
_gene_aggregated_filtered_route: This config is tuned to produce the FILTERED, GENE-AGGREGATED analysis tables from the current score_input_data.json (including newly added score sources). The gene-aggregated filter step (create_gene_aggregated_filtered_table.py) appends the ~65 variant-level boolean membership columns + the ~68 'ensg_'-prefixed gene-level filter columns onto each gene-aggregated *_eval analysis table via row-preserving LEFT joins (the linker step is skipped because the gene-aggregated *_eval table already carries 'ensg'). It takes ONE --input per invocation, so the four gene-aggregated _eval tables (outer/inner x eval/deduped) get one step each. NB: create_gene_aggregated_filtered_table.py does NOT accept --compact-dtypes, so 'compact_dtypes' must not appear in its passthrough. Out-of-scope steps (pairwise, pairwise_consolidated, the variant-level created_variant_scores_filtered_tables) are disabled; the eval-table builders are disabled because eval tables do not depend on score sources and already exist. skip_download is true because 16 of the 20 raw score sources (plus the linker, evals, and filters) are already local and unchanged; only the 4 newly declared score sources (MutScore, SNPred_scores, VEST4_MetaRNN_scores, scores_prior) need fetching, which is done in a targeted download rather than re-pulling ~22GB. All score-derived intermediates (variant_scores_all_*, percentile tables, gene_aggregated/*_ensg_stats, gene-aggregated *_eval/*_eval_deduped) are stale (they carry only 17 of the 27 currently-declared score fields) and are rebuilt from scratch with overwrite=true.
